title: On a phone the Shop supplies field sits in the summary block and can be edited
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Use a phone, or a browser window narrowed to 390 pixels wide, signed in to the same account.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Approved, whose Shop supplies amount is $15.00.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Shop supplies" shows $15.00 in the work order's summary block on the phone layout.

Step 2:

  • "Shop supplies" reads $18.00.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11767 (Story 10, Shop supplies on internal and no-charge work orders)

  • Story 10, Form factor: “Form factor: Mobile-optimized for the field on the work order (it sits in the existing summary block); desktop only for the settings row.”
  • S10-R2: “The amount can be changed on the work order until it is closed, with the existing per-work-order shop supplies control. Any customer change while the work order stays internal or no charge, or converting to no charge, resets it to the customer's Min. Making the work order billable again drops the flat amount and applies the customer's or the location's shop supplies rule as on any billable work order.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
